rows.en:
Don't mention it. Feel free to rely on me
anytime. Hehe, see you.

(Claire-senpai's so caring and grown-up...
Klan-senpai, on the other hand, looks younger
than me no matter how you look at it...)

(Claire-senpai and Klan-senpai...
I'll probably be counting on them a lot,
so I'd better make sure we get along.)

(Ugh, this is bad...
I was only trying to get to the library,
and now I'm lost inside my own school...)

I'm \p.
It's nice to meet you too.

Sorry, \p-chan...
Would you mind waiting a little
before I show you to the library?

(Michel-kun, what on earth did you do
to this kid...?)
I'm \p.

(Claire-senpai's so caring and grown-up...
Klan-senpai, on the other hand, looks younger
than me no matter how you look at it...)

(Claire-senpai and Klan-senpai...
I'll probably be counting on them a lot,
so I'd better make sure we get along.)
(All this shopping's made me hungry...)
rows.notes: Also used with variant 'single' and in a non-dialogue entry (speaker '-'); gender-neutral.

rows.en:
(I know, I'll grab lunch at the Super
Dimension Restaurant, Nyan-Nyan.)
rows.notes: Choujikuu Hanten 'Nyan-Nyan': 'Super Dimension Restaurant' not in the glossary (Nyan-Nyan is). Shared male/female.

rows.en: Welcome to Nyan-Nyan!
Wait, huh? Nanase?
Oh, if it isn't \p-kun.

Oh right, Nanase, you work part-time
at Nyan-Nyan, don't you?

Yes, that's right.
This is the first time we've run into each other
while I'm at work here, isn't it...

Oops, I'd better cut the chatter,
or the manager will scold me.
What would you like to order?
Let's see... Then I'll have the Galaxy Ramen.
rows.notes: Ginga Raamen -> 'Galaxy Ramen'; menu item not in the glossary.

rows.en:
Certainly.
Please wait just a moment.
(Haah, I can't wait for my Galaxy Ramen...)

Here you are! One Fried Dragon Chicken
set meal, sorry for the wait!
rows.notes: Ranka ('??? (woman)') bringing the wrong order. okyakusama (customer) not rendered as sir/ma'am: shared by both player genders. 'Fried Dragon Chicken' not in the glossary.

rows.en:
Huh?
But I only ordered the Galaxy Ramen...

Ranka-san,
the Fried Dragon Chicken set goes to Table 3.

...Ah!
I-I'm so sorry about that!

You'd better hurry and serve Table 3.
The manager's watching, too...
R-right! Thanks, Nana-chan!

Sorry, \p-kun.
Ranka-san can be a bit of a scatterbrain
sometimes...
I'm so sorry about earlier.
rows.notes: To the player as a customer (okyakusama).

rows.en: Nah, don't worry about it.

\p-kun says it's fine,
so don't worry, Ranka-san.

Huh?
Nana-chan, you know this customer?
Yes, we're classmates.
rows.notes: Kurasumeito as in the Japanese, though c21168 had Nanase in a different course.

rows.en:
Ohh, I see.
Then I'd better introduce myself too.

I'm Ranka Lee.
I go to St. Maria Academy, so we're at different
schools, but it's nice to meet you!
Nice to meet you too, Ranka.

St. Maria Academy... That's the famous
prestigious school for young ladies, right?

My big bro kept nagging me,
"You're going to St. Maria for high school,
no matter what!"
Huh, so you have an older brother, Ranka?

Yes. He's a kind, great big brother, but
he's a little too overprotective of me.
I'm not a little kid anymore...

That just shows how much he cares
about you, Ranka.

Of course I know that.
For my sake, he even quit being a pilot
because it's dangerous, and took a desk job.
He really is a good brother, huh.
He is, but...

I kinda wish he'd stop bragging about me
and showing my pictures off to the people
at his company...
Y-yeah, that's definitely a bit much...

I'm sure Ozma-san just wanted to show lots
of people how cute you are, Ranka-san.
I understand exactly how Ozma-san feels...
I'd do the same...!
rows.notes: watashi datte...! = 'me too / I would too'.

rows.en: C-cut it out, Nana-chan...
(Nanase really does adore Ranka, huh.)

(And this Ozma-san, Ranka's brother,
seems to dote on her a whole lot too...)

(I hope I can become good friends
with Ranka too.)

(Hmm, but I feel like I'm forgetting
something important...)

Sorry to interrupt when you're all
having such a good chat, but...

Huh?
What's wrong?
When's my Galaxy Ramen coming?

Aaah! I'm so sorry!
Just a moment, please,
\p-kun!!

R-Ranka-san!
The manager will get mad if you run
in the restaurant!

(Haha, Ranka sure is an energetic girl.
She's never boring to watch...)
(I kinda get why everyone likes Ranka.)

(All this shopping's
made me hungry...)
Oh, if it isn't \p-san.

Oh right, Nanase, you work part-time
at Nyan-Nyan, don't you?
Let's see... Then I'll have the Galaxy Ramen.

(Haah,
I can't wait for my Galaxy Ramen...)

Huh?
But I only ordered the Galaxy Ramen...

Sorry, \p-san.
Ranka-san can be a bit of a scatterbrain
sometimes...
Oh, don't worry about it.

\p-san says it's fine,
so don't worry, Ranka-san.
Nice to meet you too, Ranka-chan.

St. Maria Academy... That's the famous
prestigious school for young ladies, isn't it?
Oh, so you have an older brother, Ranka-chan?

That just shows how much he cares
about you, Ranka-chan.
He really is a good brother, then.
(Nanase really does adore Ranka-chan, huh.)
